verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented first-party way to operate FireHydrant with natural-language commands. Its AI features (summaries, AI-drafted retrospectives, Copilot suggestions, meeting transcription) produce generated content rather than accept natural-language instructions. The `/fh` Slack command is a structured slash command, and the official MCP server is an API bridge for external AI clients, which belongs to a separate story and does not show natural-language command operation within the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
